description: This file defines a template class 'scoped_resource' implementing RAII for resource management, along with helper classes and typedefs for managing pointers, arrays, and FILE pointers with automatic cleanup.

classes.name: scoped_resource
classes.description: A template class managing a resource with a customizable release policy, implementing RAII.

classes.name: scoped_ptr
classes.description: A typedef-like class managing a single object pointer with delete policy.

classes.name: scoped_array
classes.description: A typedef-like class managing an array pointer with delete[] policy.

methods.name: operator resource_type() const
methods.description: Allows implicit conversion to the resource type, providing access to the underlying resource.

methods.name: operator->() const
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to the resource if it is a pointer.

methods.name: assign(const resource_type& o)
methods.description: Releases current resource and assigns a new one.
